notes: The brief names a specific object and nothing that happens on it — a named Edwardian liner with two red funnels, two masts and 75 lifeboats that the player can walk on — so no game type is discernible and this is the ordinary No Genre outcome rather than a genre invented to avoid it. With no shape row I answered the axes directly: the author explicitly asked for exterior decks plus cabins and the bridge, which is outside-to-inside movement (P3), and a liner's boat deck, promenade and bridge sit above one another, which is stacked (P2); both come from what was stated, not from silence. I took Explorable Place, kept its landmark and circulation picks — the twin red funnels and masts are the silhouette, the decks and corridors are the route — dropped photo vignettes as unasked, and added enterable interiors for the cabins and bridge. Had a genre been named this would have been vehicle-deck; the 75 lifeboats and the Red Funnel livery are stated details no option carries, so they belong in the image prompt as free text with the count.
